The company operates as a digital marketplace for live entertainment, helping users discover, book, and manage artists for corporate events, weddings, festivals, private parties, and other live experiences.

about_short_description.short_description: Soul Artists is a Dubai-based entertainment technology and talent-booking platform.

product.name: Live Entertainment Booking Platform
product.description: A digital marketplace connecting event organizers with performing artists and musicians for live entertainment bookings.

product.name: Artist Application and Vetting Service
product.description: A service allowing performers to apply to join the platform, with manual review to ensure quality and professionalism.

product.name: Instant Quote Request Feature
product.description: A tool that allows event organizers to submit event details and receive real-time applications and quotes from relevant artists.

product.name: Secure Payment and Escrow Service
product.description: A payment system that holds funds securely and offers a money-back guarantee if the artist cancels or fails to perform.

product.name: Direct Messaging and Negotiation Tool
product.description: A communication feature that allows clients and artists to discuss event details and negotiate booking terms before confirmation.

product.name: Artist Review and Rating System
product.description: A system that allows clients to rate and review artists after events to provide feedback and maintain platform standards.
